# TildaZ v0.10.6

**Faster CJK and emoji output, snappier typing on macOS, and a one-line installer.**

- Install with one command: `curl -LsSf https://ensky0.github.io/tildaz/install.sh | sh` on Linux and macOS, `powershell -ExecutionPolicy ByPass -c "irm https://ensky0.github.io/tildaz/install.ps1 | iex"` on Windows. Run it again to update; `uninstall.sh` / `uninstall.ps1` remove it. ([#803](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/803))
- CJK and emoji-heavy output is processed up to twice as fast on all platforms. ([#812](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/812))
- Linux: output no longer gets stuck until you press a key (for example after `top` or `cd`), and large outputs finish faster. This started in v0.10.5. ([#817](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/817), [#814](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/814))
- macOS: typing is responsive again; the extra key-to-screen delay added in v0.10.5 is gone. ([#811](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/811))

## Downloads

| Platform | File | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Linux portable (glibc 2.28+) | `tildaz-v0.10.6-linux-{x86_64,aarch64}.tar.gz` | Extract and run `./install.sh --release`; no `sudo`. |
| Linux Debian / Ubuntu | `tildaz_0.10.6-1_{amd64,arm64}.deb` | Install with `dpkg` or a graphical software installer. |
| Linux Fedora / RHEL / openSUSE | `tildaz-0.10.6-1.{x86_64,aarch64}.rpm` | Install with `dnf` or the distro package tool. |
| Linux distro-independent | `TildaZ-0.10.6-{x86_64,aarch64}.AppImage` | Make executable and run; FUSE is optional. |
| Arch / Manjaro / EndeavourOS | `tildaz-0.10.6-1-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst` | x86_64 package. |
| macOS 14+ universal | `tildaz-v0.10.6-macos.dmg` | Apple Silicon and Intel; stable self-signed identity, not notarized. |
| Windows 10/11 x64 | `tildaz-v0.10.6-win-x64.zip` | Unzip and keep `_internal\` next to `tildaz.exe`. |
| Windows 11 ARM64 | `tildaz-v0.10.6-win-arm64.zip` | ARM64-native binary; same layout as the x64 zip. |
